body: NHSA (first 商保创新药目录 price consultation)
detail: First-ever commercial-insurance innovative-drug price consultation, day 4 of the 2025 negotiations, with five CAR-T makers (Fosun Kite, JW, IASO, Juventas, CARsgen); expert panel included insurers for the first time
stated_reason_verbatim: 11月2日，北京国家医保谈判现场迎来历史性一刻。在2025年医保谈判第四日，复星凯特、药明巨诺、驯鹿生物、合源生物、科济药业五家CAR-T药企代表陆续入场，参与首次设立的“商保创新药目录价格协商”。
notes: Gloss as in detail. Same article: 患者自费负担有望从百万元级别降至四万元左右 (out-of-pocket hoped to fall to about 40,000 CNY, an expectation, not a decision). 121 drugs passed formal review for the commercial list and 534 for the basic list (中国医药报 2025-08-12, https://m.cnpharm.com/c/2025-08-12/1077975.shtml).

detail: No CAR-T in the basic NRDL 2025 (2,800-plus entries, no 奥仑赛 entry); five CAR-Ts placed on the separate commercial list instead. Stated industry reason for repeated NRDL failure: the informal price rule that drugs above 500,000 CNY a year are not negotiated and above 300,000 not admitted
stated_reason_verbatim: 过往数年，CAR-T细胞治疗产品多次冲击医保谈判失败。业内普遍认为，这与国家医保谈判“50万不谈，30万不进”的规则有关。
source_doc: 第一财经 via 新浪财经 2025-12-07; basic NRDL 2025 attachment (grep)
notes: Gloss: for years CAR-T failed the NRDL negotiations; industry attributes this to the rule 'above 500k not negotiated, above 300k not admitted'. The absence from the basic list is verified from the attachment (https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202512/P020251207694651387946.pdf); the reason is press attribution, not an NHSA statement. Same article: a CAR-T company said the commercial-list price cut was 不低于15%, larger than Huiminbao discounts.

detail: 《基因治疗产品非临床研究与评价技术指导原则（试行）》 and 《基因修饰细胞治疗产品非临床研究技术指导原则（试行）》 issued; a companion 《基因治疗产品长期随访临床研究技术指导原则（试行）》 issued 2021-12-01
stated_reason_verbatim: 为规范国内基因治疗产品非临床研究与评价，引导行业健康发展，提高企业研发效率，在国家药品监督管理局的部署下，药审中心组织制定了《基因治疗产品非临床研究与评价技术指导原则(试行)》(见附件1)、《基因修饰细胞治疗产品非临床研究技术指导原则(试行)》(见附件2)。
source_doc: 国家药监局药审中心关于发布…的通告（2021年第49号）, mirrored by 中国食品药品国际交流中心 (ccfdie.org)
notes: Gloss: CDE issues non-clinical guidelines for gene therapy and gene-modified cell therapy products. Long-term follow-up guideline date from 摩熵医药 2021-12-06 (https://www.pharnexcloud.com/zixun/zc_3964, provisional).

detail: Three further CGT guidelines issued between April 2022 and 2023: GMP guideline for cell therapy products, CMC guideline for immune cell therapy products, CMC guideline for in vitro gene-modification vectors
stated_reason_verbatim: From April 2022 to 2023, the Center for Food and Drug Inspection of the National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) has issued three new guidelines, “the guideline for good manufacturing practice of cell therapy products,” “the guideline for pharmaceutical research and evaluation of immune cell therapy products,” and “the guideline for pharmaceutical research and evaluation on in vitro genetic modification vectors.
source_doc: Report from the 6th Asia Partnership Conference of Regenerative Medicine, April 20, 2023 (PMC11550569)
notes: Chinese titles: 《细胞治疗产品生产质量管理指南（试行）》, 《免疫细胞治疗产品药学研究与评价技术指导原则（试行）》, 《体外基因修饰系统药学研究与评价技术指导原则（试行）》; trade sources date the two CMC guidelines (with 《体内基因治疗产品药学研究与评价技术指导原则（试行）》) to 2022-05-26, not verified from CDE.

detail: 《细胞和基因治疗产品临床相关沟通交流技术指导原则》 issued, effective on publication
stated_reason_verbatim: 为指导和规范细胞和基因治疗产品临床研发过程中沟通交流的资料准备和临床研发要素考虑等工作，以提高沟通交流效率，促进细胞和基因治疗产品的临床研发，药审中心组织制定了《细胞和基因治疗产品临床相关沟通交流技术指导原则》（见附件）。
source_doc: 国家药监局药审中心关于发布《细胞和基因治疗产品临床相关沟通交流技术指导原则》的通告（2023年第60号）, 发布日期 20231229, signed 2023年12月28日
notes: Read from a saved copy of the CDE page (pharmwyp.com PDF); CDE site itself returns a JavaScript challenge. Gloss: guideline on clinical-stage communication meetings for CGT products.

notes: Gloss: NMPA issued the clinical-pharmacology guideline for cell therapy products in November 2024. A 2024-01 AAV in vivo gene therapy CMC guideline for IND (《重组腺相关病毒载体类体内基因治疗产品临床试验申请药学研究与评价技术指导原则》) is reported by trade sources only (provisional, not rowed).

detail: Dual-track: hospital investigator-initiated trials under NHC oversight as medical technology versus NMPA registrational CTAs; Legend's CARTIFAN-1 CTA approved March 2018; Fosun Kite's FKC876 IND approved August 2018 (批件号2018L02991)
stated_reason_verbatim: Following consultation, and subject to oversight by scientific advisory boards and ethical committees, clinicians in China can initiate clinical testing for experimental cell therapies at their hospitals without the requirement for clearance of a formal IND application by the NMPA as part of the NMPA’s encouragement of innovation.
source_doc: Legend Biotech Form 20-F for fiscal 2025
notes: Fosun Kite IND date from 21jingji 2021-06-23 (2018年8月，CDE正式批准了复星凯特的IND申请（批件号2018L02991）). Legend: We obtained approval to conduct confirmatory clinical trial, CARTIFAN-1, through multiple centers in China in March 2018.

body: ClinicalTrials.gov and ChiCTR counts (Wei et al. review)
detail: 357 CAR-T trials registered in China on ClinicalTrials.gov as of 30 June 2020, plus about 150 further trials on ChiCTR; China overtook the US in registered CAR-T trials in September 2017
stated_reason_verbatim: According to the data from the clinicaltrials.gov website, China became the country with the most registered CAR T trials in September 2017. As of June 30, 2020, the number of registered CAR T trials in China has reached 357. In addition, as many as 150 other CAR T trials have been registered on ChiCTR.
source_doc: Wei J et al. Clinical development of CAR T cell therapy in China: 2020 update. Cell Mol Immunol 2021;18:792-804 (PMID 32999455)
notes: Abstract read via PubMed E-utilities.
